intro: A natural herbal formulation enriched with powerful botanicals like Arjuna, Giloy, Amalaki & Tulsi, crafted to maintain healthy cholesterol levels and promote cardiovascular wellness. This Ayurvedic juice blend supports heart health, improves circulation, and helps prevent plaque buildup in arteries.

p: Mix 30 mL of Cholesterol Care Juice with 30 mL warm water. Consume on an empty stomach in the morning or 30 minutes after dinner. Recommended dosage: 30 mL daily or as directed by physician.
